definitions.retained_update_fraction: sqrt(v_raw)/(sqrt(v_raw)+probe_epsilon); this is 1 minus the removed fraction
definitions.log_scale: M=exp(b)*m_raw and V=exp(2*b)*v_raw; all calculations avoid reconstructing raw tiny moments
definitions.cosine_update_zero: Counterfactual using the SAME stored moments and epsilon=0; not a separately trained trajectory
definitions.moment_timing: Stored m/v include the gradient used for the preceding update; the frozen-moment comparison does not advance recurrence
definitions.current_gradient: Mean-logistic gradient reevaluated at stored post-update weights; scalar rescaling preserves its direction
definitions.update_direction: Negative preconditioned first moment; the common positive learning-rate scalar is omitted
definitions.source_invalid_control: A fixed probe epsilon is applied even when the source trajectory used INVALID_wrong_scale; source config remains labeled
definitions.limitations: Finite-state geometry does not prove convergence or identify author code. Fractions can round to zero; log fractions remain available. No new training is performed.
